cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Warmth with a Countdown
cards.instruction: Perform increasing warmth with increasingly final language, as though every act of care might also be a goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I've packed extra sandwiches for your journey. You always forget to eat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm only visiting the next town.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then they'll keep you well as long as you choose to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only because I want the last thing you hear here to be kindness.
